messages:
ashwin: Heads-up — AP-S6a pool is showing several nodes dropping from the scheduler with no graceful shutdown. Jobs get killed mid-token and some pods restart on other hosts. Seeing rising corrected memory counters and an NMI before disappearance, so I'm going to proactively drain 3 suspicious hosts and bring warm-spares online.

maria: copying. Which node IDs and racks? any correlation with PSU or thermal?

ashwin: node-aps6a-07 and node-aps6a-08 and node-aps6a-11, racks aps6a-rack07/08/11. No PSU warnings in Prometheus but GPU corrected memory errors are spiking. Sample kernel snippet: 
`````
Nov 12 03:12:22 node-07 kernel: mce: CPU reported APEI: corrected error
Nov 12 03:12:22 node-07 nv_gpu: corrected memory 0x4f
Nov 12 03:12:23 node-07 ipmi: host unexpectedly lost connection
`````

jonah: thanks. I'll start warming 2 hot-spares in aps-east and migrate lower-priority batch workloads to eu-west to free capacity. Expect ~12–18% capacity reduction if we drain those 3. @kevin can you pause the long training queue?

kevin: pausing queue 'long-train' now :white_check_mark: Also throttling large-alloc requests by 30% until we stabilize.

infra-bot: autoscaler: initiated warmup for spare-pool-aps6a (2 nodes). Estimated readiness ~8m.

lisa: note — Dedicated customers in aps6a have burst SLAs; if we move too much traffic we could hit contractual limits. Suggest routing only 40% of non-dedicated traffic to fallback region.

ashwin: agreed. Proposed temporary route weights: aps6a=60, aps1=40 for 30 minutes. Apply fallback policy and don't touch dedicated-lane. Command to run: 
`````
redwood route set --region aps6a --weight 60 --region aps1 --weight 40 --ttl 1800
`````

jonah: routing change applied on control-plane; controller reports new weights. Early checks: tail latency for cross-region calls increased ~80ms for affected endpoints but still within SLO. Tracing: no increased error percentage yet.

maria: opening ticket with vendor for nodes 07/08/11, asking for firmware diagnostic dump and memory board check. Will include kernel logs and coredumps. Tagging support@vendor and hw-rma.

kevin: quick cost heads-up — extra warm-spares + cross-region egress will add ~2.3% to infra burn if this recurs monthly. Filing an ops-cost note.

ashwin: plan summary: 1) drain the three nodes, 2) warm 2 spares and shift non-dedicated traffic 40% to aps1, 3) vendor RMA if diagnostics point to memory board or DIMM faults, 4) re-evaluate in 40 minutes. /cc @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: acknowledged. Monitoring dashboards and paging thresholds set. Will escalate if error rate > 1% or if warm-spares fail to join.
